prd_requirements: 在下单之前，显示用户的可用保证金数量
native_testing: Paused at user request. No device testing, device tools or APK installation this increment. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: Four independently signed opening preflight GETs: position mode, symbol positionRisk, asset mode, accountWithJoinMargin. Shared EOA signer and nonce allocator.
Exact USDT availableBalance and per-asset available balances, eligibility and mode shown in form and confirmation. Unknown, zero, negative and tiny amounts remain distinct.
Account symbol positions reconciled with signed positionRisk; partial funds failure blocks ordinary opening without losing inputs.
Reference new opening exposure nets the opposite one-way position, opens hedge side in full, and is zero for valid reduce-only.
Reference additional opening initial margin = new exposure times limit/reference mark divided by leverage, with decimal/rational arithmetic.
Expiry covers all preflight prompts; late read signatures do not send expired GETs or trigger additional prompts.
Dedicated single/batch closes opt out of funds reads; a funds-free context cannot authorize ordinary opening.
evidence: Existing close and batch protocol/regression tests all pass in full suite.
boundaries: The account availableBalance is documented as USDT-only, not an aggregate multi-asset collateral valuation.
Unknown amounts are never replaced with wallet balance, withdrawal limits or demo funds; missing optional amount remains unknown.
Estimates exclude fees, funding, existing orders, released margin, actual execution price, risk tiers and later activity. Aster checks actual availability and eligibility.
Single-asset above-balance comparison is advisory, not an extra hard affordability rule; multi-asset collateral totals are not guessed.
True canTrade is not proof of real authorization; false blocks ordinary openings.
Aster enable-trading and actual EOA user/signer acceptance remain unverified.
Independent reverse and isolated-margin adjustment are not defined in current fetched Futures/Portfolio PRDs; classified as product questions instead of invented mandatory scope.
Overall PRD in progress; BAPI historical statistics and TWAP skipped at user request.
